summary: Plan to restyle and modernize the Admin Dashboard (SuperAdminPortal) into an executive white theme with frosted glassmorphism cards (liquid glass / frosted glass with subtle blur, white/75-85 translucency, crisp slate typography, and medical teal & cyan accents). Includes redesign of the security PIN lock gate, metric KPI glass cards, tab bar, doctors table, plan management cards, AI control center, and modal dialogs while preserving 100% of functional capabilities and Arabic/English bilingual support.
